clos.original_description: Describe how generative AI models work at an intuitive, non-mathematical level.
clos.enriched_description: Describe how generative AI models work at an intuitive, non-mathematical level. The scope includes Introduction to the Generative AI Landscape; What generative AI is and isn't; From single models to multi-model systems; Foundations and Intuition of Generative Models; Discriminative vs generative models; Attention, intuitively; and Prompting and steering image models.

clos.original_description: Apply prompt engineering techniques to obtain useful, reliable outputs from generative models.
clos.enriched_description: Apply prompt engineering techniques to obtain useful, reliable outputs from generative models. The scope includes Prompt Engineering Fundamentals, Advanced Prompt Engineering and Evaluation, and Prompt Engineering and Evaluation.

clos.original_description: Build a small generative AI application end to end, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output validation, basic agent/tool use, and an appropriate customization strategy (prompting, RAG, or fine-tuning).
clos.enriched_description: Build a small generative AI application end to end, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output validation, basic agent/tool use, and an appropriate customization strategy (prompting, RAG, or fine-tuning). The scope includes Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Why grounding matters; the RAG pipeline, RAG evaluation and failure modes, Building Generative AI Applications, Agents and Tool Use, When NOT to use an agent, Model Customization Strategies, and The customization ladder.

clos.original_description: Evaluate generative AI outputs and systems using rubrics, test sets, model-as-judge methods, and analysis of failure modes.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate generative AI outputs and systems using rubrics, test sets, model-as-judge methods, and analysis of failure modes. The scope includes Model-as-judge with verification, Building Generative AI Applications, and Evaluation and Failure Modes.

clos.original_description: Analyze the ethical, social, legal, and governance implications of generative AI and apply responsible-use practices.
clos.enriched_description: Analyze the ethical, social, legal, and governance implications of generative AI and apply responsible-use practices. The scope includes Society, Law, and Governance and Governance inside organisations.
